description: Undo a partial deletion of ONE video before it is executed: the qualities/backup come back. Without qualities and backup, everything pending for the video is restored. Refused once the final deletion has started. Does not recover videos in the trash.

backup.description: true = remove the original uploaded file (backup)

qualities.description: Qualities to remove, as in the video's available_resolutions (e.g. ['1080p', '720p'])

name: panda_cancel_partial_deletion
title: Cancel Partial Deletion
